schedule.title: “There’s No Place Like Home” Bash
schedule.desc: Info: Not heading off to Europe? Don’t get FOMO and come out to toast our musical family while while they travel to meet cute Dutch guys and make us proud with some fabulous concerts in Amsterdam and London. We will have reserved tables on the outside patio and lots of fellowship that does not involve an airplane.  Bring your plus one and enjoy No Host drinks and food at your expense and if there are enough participants we might get some complimentary pizzas thrown in.  Please RSVP soonest but no later than Wednesday, July 29th, to help with a projected headcount.  See you there!

schedule.title: Walking somewhere over the rainbow: Queer\, American and Judy Garland London Walking Tour- Previous RSVP Required
schedule.desc:
Call time: 9:50 AM
Info: London Walking Tour hosted by a LGMC member, Martin Kaufman. 
Only 23 spots available for GMCLA, a few spots are still available. Please email Catie if you are interested in participating. Please do not show up to the tour if you have not RSVPed. 
Start: Outside the London Palladium theatre at 8 Argyle Street, Soho, London W1F 7TF. Could everyone get there by 09.50am for a prompt 10am start to the walk.
 
We will have a comfort break somewhere half way along
 
End: Outside the Benjamin Franklin House, 36 Craven Street, off The Strand, London WC2N, which is about five minutes’ walk from St Paul’s Covent Garden, where you will be performing on the following two days.
 
We will finish around 12.30pm so we have time to eat lunch before our rehearsal.
schedule.location: London Palladium Theater 8 Argyle Street, Soho, London W1F 7TF
